goal.justification: The complete 47-function Memory Match scene/factory run is reconstructed as one real dScMgMemory_c C++ translation unit. All address-only behavior is attached to class members, the five PMF state tables are typed, the 0x270 shared state has compiler-owned destruction, and the scene/card/player/cursor layout is explicit. Seventeen iterator-heavy methods retain localized byte-offset views because direct typed array spellings were measured and changed register allocation, scheduling, or code size; those are documented compiler boundaries, not unknown ownership. The sole extern-C definition is the classInit allocation bridge retained at the measured CW 1.2 folded-construction wall.

notes: 2026-09-03 real-member reconstruction: all 38 address-only scene functions are genuine dScMgMemory_c members with descriptive names. Five PMF tables built by __sinit_ov006_021311c8 independently fix their groupings and order: main StateSetup/StatePlay/StateJudge/StateResult/StateExit; round RoundStart/RoundDealEasy/RoundDealNormal/RoundDealHard/RoundWaitDeal/RoundReveal; result ResultWait/ResultReward/ResultTurnCards/ResultFinish; card CardMove/CardIdle/CardSelect/CardFlipUp/CardWait/CardFlipDown/CardFlyAway; player PlayerDrop/PlayerMove/PlayerWait.

COINED NAMES, the one thing not provable: the 38 handler/helper ROM symbols were address-only, so no recovered spelling exists to confirm or contradict the descriptive names in functions[]. The ROM proves their dScMgMemory_c ownership and the PMF tables prove state-group identities; exact original source spellings are disclosed as unknown here and in symbols/actor_renames.tsv.

ROM-PROVEN LAYOUT: the unique MG_MEMORY factory allocates 0x5340 bytes. Matched access patterns prove twelve 0x18-byte cards, three 0x14-byte player markers, a 0x10-byte cursor, signed ready/deal counters, and the scene-state tail. The shared 0x270 object at 0x4f38 has its measured Dealer_Destruct destructor, so C++ owns reverse-order scene teardown.

MEASURED CODEWARRIOR EMISSION BOUNDARY: the default deferred code generator makes the last optimization state win across an apparent pragma push/pop. Global defer_codegen off makes definitions emit eagerly in ROM-ascending source order, allowing DrawCards' opt_propagation off and CardFlyAway's opt_lifetimes off to be scoped with push/pop. The resulting single object emits all 47 text sections byte-exact and in cartridge order.

MEASURED ITERATOR-SPELLING BOUNDARY: direct typed mCards/mPlayers expressions were tested in the remaining 17 offset-view methods. They changed strength reduction, base-address formation, register allocation, or section size despite identical semantics. The public class layout remains typed; those localized implementation views preserve demonstrated mwccarm 1.2 code generation rather than substituting prettier non-matching code.

MEASURED CW 1.2 FACTORY WALL: dScMgMemory_c_classInit is allocation plus a fully folded scene construction sequence. Semantic placement construction is unavailable in this compiler setup, so the literal classInit bridge preserves allocation size, base construction, vptr transitions, Particle::SysTracker construction and shared-state construction explicitly and byte-exact.

Historical focused verification limitation (fresh measurements recorded separately): FOCUSED VERIFY LIMITATION: tools/tubuild.py verify reports 46/47 because objisolate rejects the classInit's R_ARM_ABS32 relocation with addend zero against _ZTV13dScMgMemory_c emitted by the same object. Extracted factory bytes match individually and all 47 text sections occur in cartridge order; the production linker and full ROM build are the authority for that same-object vtable relocation.

Historical text-only promotion boundary, superseded by initializer/BSS ownership and this native208-byte enrollment: CURRENT NON-TEXT BOUNDARY: this promotion owns the complete contiguous .text run only. The five PMF tables, resource/static data, compiler-generated RTTI/vtable, __sinit_ov006_021311c8 and 0x021422a4..0x021423a8 BSS remain ROM-gap owned until their exact input-section order and initializers are reconstructed. The production rombuild is 106/106 and stock-identical; a post-promotion tubuild linkcheck currently refuses this valid text-only promotion at intact-object preparation because it requires at least one non-text claim, so the recorded pre-promotion 47/47 full linkcheck remains the single-object relocation proof.

tubuild create warnings (RESOLVED): the generated extern-C wrapper and declaration-conflict markers were reconciled in place. No TUBUILD CONFLICT marker remains in the source; this note retains the fact that the legacy fragments disagreed while making the resolution status explicit.

Historical initializer fold, before native PMFs: Static initializer folded: the fifteen-entry sprite-pointer table plus the five PMF state tables (0x021422a4..0x021423a8) move out of the handwritten src/unnamed shard into src/minigames/d_s_mg_memory.cpp, defined through the existing dScMgMemory_cState/dScMgMemory_cCardState typedefs (the player table keeps the shard no-arg grouping; no enrolled consumer names it yet) and plain-copied from the ROM constants. The emitted .init, .ctor and .bss are byte-identical to retail; no handles, no compiler temporaries, no renames. Table definition order is the retail initializer copy order.

Native data-memory-native1018 owns the entire648-byte initialized data group, including25native PMFs, typed profile, own RTTI/name/full152-byte vtable and all seven card tables. Player dispatch is void(int), RoundWaitDeal void() without casts; historical signature unproven. Factory returns typed scene pointer with unchanged manual construction.
